LightningComponentBundle.description: Add a saved card or ACH payment method to an Account.

property.name: paymentGatewayId
property.label: Payment Gateway Record ID
property.description: Preferred unique org-specific record ID of the active PaymentGateway.

property.name: paymentGatewayName
property.label: Payment Gateway Name
property.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Used only when Payment Gateway Record ID is blank; the name must identify one active gateway.

property.name: componentTitle
property.label: Component title
property.description: Title shown at the top of this component.

property.name: submitButtonLabel
property.label: Submit button label
property.description: Text shown on the create button.

property.name: defaultPaymentType
property.label: Default payment type
property.description: Payment type selected when the component opens.

property.name: showPaymentTypeSwitcher
property.label: Show Card / ACH switcher
property.description: Allow users to switch between card and ACH entry.

property.name: defaultScenario
property.label: Default payment response
property.description: Response associated with the tokenized method. A decline is returned when a payment is later processed.

property.name: showOutcomeSelector
property.label: Allow response selection
property.description: Let users choose the payment response when saving a method. Hidden by default for a standard payment experience.

property.name: autoFillBillingAddress
property.label: Pre-fill Account billing address
property.description: Use the Account billing address as the initial billing address in the form.
